card.name: Large clique subdivisions in a pinned graph

task.name: Large clique subdivisions in a pinned graph
task.description: construct() -> {'branches': distinct vertices, 'paths': one simple path for each unordered pair of branches}. Path endpoints must be their branch pair; all path interiors must be pairwise disjoint and avoid every branch. All consecutive path vertices must be adjacent in the pinned graph. Maximize number of branch vertices. A local G(24,0.4) sample (random.Random(585)) is pinned. A certificate is a lower bound on this host’s largest subdivision order; no theorem about all chromatic graphs or reproduction of the paper’s proof is claimed.
